title: Customer-Pay Repairs Terms Schedule: Quoted Price Hold and Drop-Off Deposit by Tier
content:
Schedule to the Customer-Pay Repairs repair order terms. For each service tier it states how long a written estimate's quoted price is held for opening a repair order, the deposit taken at drop-off and the quoted total from which that deposit is taken, and whether parts wait for the deposit.

## Schedule

| Service tier | Quoted price hold (calendar days after the estimate written date) | Deposit (percent of the quoted total) | Quoted total at or above which a deposit is taken (USD) | Parts ordered only after the deposit is received |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paintless Dent Repair Service | 30 | 0 | 0.00 | No |
| Cosmetic Touch-Up Service | 30 | 0 | 0.00 | No |
| Bumper Refinish Service | 30 | 25 | 500.00 | Yes |
| Panel Repair Service | 30 | 30 | 500.00 | Yes |
| Customer-Pay Collision Service | 30 | 50 | 1000.00 | Yes |
| Complete Refinish Service | 60 | 50 | 1000.00 | Yes |

## Defined terms

- **Quoted price hold**: Calendar days after the estimate written date during which the quoted price is honored when the repair order opens (integer).
- **Deposit percentage**: Deposit taken at drop-off as a percentage of the quoted total (percent).
- **Deposit threshold**: Quoted total at or above which a deposit is taken (USD).
- **Parts after deposit**: Whether parts are ordered only after the deposit is received (boolean).

## Reading the schedule

- The hold is 30 calendar days in every tier except the Complete Refinish Service, where it is 60.
- The threshold is inclusive ("at or above"). Hypothetical quoted totals on a Panel Repair Service order: 500.00 is at the 500.00 threshold, so a deposit of 30 percent is taken; 499.99 is below it. On a Customer-Pay Collision Service order, a quoted total of 1000.00 meets the 1000.00 threshold and 999.99 does not.
- Paintless Dent Repair Service and Cosmetic Touch-Up Service show a 0 percent deposit, a 0.00 threshold and "No" for parts after deposit; the four other tiers order parts only after the deposit is received.
